reviews.text: Not a bad app at all. When I felt like giving up, I would open this app and remember each mile stone I’ve passed. It’s helped me in my journey

Fake community profiles. Some of the app felt useful to me but the developer has ghost profiles and fake members all over the community part of the app. Some are obvious some really aren’t. There was an account using a photo of Big Ang from Mob Wives. That one was grossly obvious. and it makes me not want to use it.
Love the Stats Component. Beautifully designed app. I love how it tracks your lungs, heart and brain recovery based on time quit.
Did not help me quit at all. Bad ui too
Over two years vape free now. If you’re reading this review I’m proud of you.. I love a tracker app and holding myself accountable

$100/Year Sub? Exploitative!. They told me how much I'll save quitting vaping. Which frees up capital for them! They calculated my savings then immediately required $100 / year or $20 month... No thanks. I'm doing fine without you.
Tells you you’re saving $ by quitting then charges you 20$ a month LOL. Why do I have to pay to keep track of days?

360 days. I am 360 days no vaping and no nicotine and I can safely say this app changed my life. It has lots of encouraging messages and it tells you not only how much progress you’ve made, but also how much your body heals day by day. This app has helped me more ways than one and it has helped keep me accountable. It is nice to look back and see how far I’ve come. It shows you how much money you save, how many vapes you’ve avoided and so much more. I can’t say enough good things about this app. Truly. Not mention it has a forum built in to allow you to talk to others who are quitting and it has resources as well. I highly recommend this app to anyone quitting nicotine and to those who are trying, don’t give up. A whole new life is just a day at a time away.
3+ years of no vaping. Kept me accountable, best decision was to quit. Frick vape brotha
Not free. App isn’t free but doesn’t state anything about making in app purchases

This app is awesome!. This app inspired me to quit and gave me positive reinforcement every time I needed help! And most of all of it for free! I couldn’t afford any other app but this app gave me a chance to be a new person and it’s helped me to quit and stay off vaping for 2 years and 33 days. I also saw that they made a quit drinking app and because of that app I actually stopped drinking. It motivated me and inspired me to actually get off drinking. the days tracking and communicating with buddy’s and the milestones helped a lot. So very proud of the developers for creating all this and allowing it to be used for free! Awesome developers gave many people the opportunity to access resources that other apps would charge unreasonably!
Buena aplicación. Es una muy buena aplicación
Super helpful. I’ve struggled with quitting nicotine and this app is super helpful. Gives motivation and other people on the app share their stories which helps me know I’m not alone

SO tired of money-hungry apps & subscriptions. Remember the good days when you could pay $0.99 $4.99 for an app and have full access forever? I saw the great reviews and thought it was free, so I downloaded it. It asks you a few preliminary questions, then immediately prompts you to pay either $99.99/year or $19.99/month. No free trial, just “pay me before you even see what I have to offer.” Not that I would ever pay that much for an app on my phone anyway. Maybe one day we’ll get apps that care more about helping people than milking subscriptions.

Waste of money. I bought this on the monthly pay plan and randomly got charged the full yearly plan. I tried to cancel it and it won’t give me my money back. When I go in the app, it doesn’t even show that I have the plan and everything is locked. It was a waste of my money and I want my money back.

Great app but… Bradley. This app helped my gf follow me on quitting, there’s a great community except for someone named… Bradley. He has joined a lot of the group chats in here and seems to be trolling to get people to vape. He says he’s paid people to quit vaping but then tells people they should vape and it’s not worth it to quit. Bradley, if you’re reading this, it’s me, your father. Come home, your mother has been so sad without you. I’m sorry for calling you a disappointment in front of all your friends. I’m proud of you.

Buggy and expensive. Does not accurately track consumption - which is the most basic feature this app claims to provide. The graphs are incorrect, the daily consumption goals don’t actually show up in the tracker, and the app support & updates are non-existent. Save yourself the $30 PER MONTH and use a simple spreadsheet.
The Best. This app is amazing. I love that you’re able to interact with other people who are on the same journey as you. It’s helped me so much with quitting!
Ridiculous price. Absolutely insane price. I find it so annoying that they show how much money you waste on vaping and then make me pay almost the same amount just to stop??? Stupidity.
Yeehaw. This app is cool because I’m able to see the progress I have made and how long I have been nicotine-free!

A simple, yet encouraging resource. This app is awesome, I’ve been free from vaping and nicotine for almost 1 year now. Unexpectedly, I found myself using the app often to talk with other community members and get a great visual on my progress. I especially love the lungs, heart, and brain stat trackers! Such a simple yet useful and encouraging app that I didn’t expect to love so much.
Love this app. Encouraging app that shows you the money you've saved!

Not worth the money. The cost of this app does not reflect the quality. Seems like a very basic UI that gets glitched/bugged out at times. Not very polished for the cost. Would not recommend this app.

NON VAPER AFTER 5 YEARS. I will say this app did its thang for me the community is so welcoming and everybody is uplifting everyone the subscription is very much worth buying just in 2 days of being vape free I felt like I have accomplished a big thing for myself WE ARE FREEEEEEEE

Payment?. You can’t even use this app without agreeing to a minimum of $14.99! For that, I might as well keep the vapes.

There is not trial run, there’s nothing you can see or use until you pay money. How do I even know if this is a good app if I can’t see anything? Crazy!
I feel scammed. The app is way too basic to charge that much money! No resources or tipps on how to quit, poor design, annoying cravings log feature…

I don’t understand. I like the app and all that but I can’t figure out how to sync the app the my Apple Watch it just says to open the app to sync it and I did that and nothing pops up I looked through all of the settings on the app and I don’t understand please fit it.
Actually Helped me. Thank you to the people who created this. It’s actually helping me.
great app. Great app, however on the Goals page, the plural of Buddy is spelled wrong. It should be “Create 2 Buddies” not Buddys
Essential for quitting vaping. There are many apps for quitting vaping, but this one is the by far the best app out there. Required for anyone looking to quit or cut back on vaping!
Best app in the world!. Life changing app, if you’re trying to quit the plan they offer is essential!

Great app, but fix subscription. I decided to by the subscription, and hit the button for the monthly renewal. Instead, the yearly subscription came up instead, but I already double tapped the button to pay. Didn’t intend to spend $100 dollars today when I was trying to pay $15

Where is costumer service?. I really want to love this app - I am liking is so far.. however when recording my craving it said I caved and vaped during this craving of which I DID NOT and it reset my progress. Man this is upsetting me so bad I am so sad :( I wanted a clean, recorded, break and then it does this to me before my first 24 hours. I wish I can find costumer service to see if they can help!!!!
I like this app it makes not vaping like a fun game. I like this app it makes not vaping like a fun game

Helps. Must have to quit vaping. Great community along with helpful tools to track progress. There is also free guided meditation on this app that could be used for non vapers funnily enough. 10/10 would not change a thing.
Vaping. I love that the app doesn’t have ads. And it’s focused on actually helping you.

Good app, but I’d do away with notifications. Downloaded the app and it’s all good, but I’d really suggest they make sure people know to turn notifications off. I didn’t do it at first, and every notification reminded me of my vape.
Helpful for Quitting. This app provides helpful advice and reminders along your quitting journey.
Day 5. No vaping isn’t easy but it’s nice having a little reward for every second passing

DEVS please LISTEN, there’s one major issue. I love this app and people are still very active on the community. But I hope the developers PLEASE SEE this review!! 

I am 451 days clean (finally) and I really value the community part of the app. However the notifications bell has been broken since I’ve even gotten the app. I’m not sure if it’s an overload, but I can never go in there and see comment responses, unless I click on the notif from my home screen, and not anywhere in-app . 

If i get a comment response while I’m on the app, it will just disappear.

Please help fix the in-app notification bell! I am missing out on talking to people who need support!
Simple and helpful. Just what I needed to stay on track and quit. Not overly complicated and stupid like the government texting services
.. How do i change my profile picture?
Please fix the widget. It currently has huge black corners on iOS 17.5.1

Lifechanging. This app really was a great support system in my decision to quit. The community on this app root for one another and all help support eachother to stick to our commitments to quit. It really kept me going and most definitely made a huge impact on my consistency with sticking to it. Thats not to say the app is a quick fix, you still have to have the willpower and mental discipline to quit. But this app gave structure and a community that I would have not ever found anywhere else. I quit vaping almost 2 years ago, and I still return to the app to see my progress and help others. Im so grateful toward the community on the app and creators of this app.
Great app. I like this app a lot it work well for me
So helpful. Really made a difference in my quitting :)
If ur looking for the best app to stop this is it. By far the best app to stop ur vaping bad habits. Love the community feature !!

Probably good!. Think the app itself seems good. UI is nice enough but you can’t track without paying around $16 for the monthly plan. I only spend $20 on vaping every month anyway, so unfortunately it isn’t worth the price for me.
Quit Vaping App. This App is magnificent and it tracks your progress every day. You should try it and it’s free
Money saver. There’s an option for vaping and cigarettes. A money saving timer calculator thing and a constant timer. I like to look at the count when I’m at work and stressed.

Bug fix please!!. Love this app, but in the community feature it’s very hard to keep up with notifications. Every time you go back to your notifications they are in a different order, and they never go away. It’s also a ton of individual notifications instead of groupings for “these people liked your post” or comment or whatever. thank you!

Best quitting app. I never write reviews on here but I had to give this one 5 stars. It’s been the only app actually help me quit vaping. The main thing it having kind of like a social media aspect to it where everyone can share their struggles, thoughts, tips & encouragement. Even if it’s from strangers. Never had problems with anyone in the app either. Everyone is genuinely going through a hard time & just wants help focusing quitting. It also helps track money you’ve saved, that feature could be a bit better there is a limit which makes it not completely accurate to everyone, but for a free app I’m honestly not complaining lol! There is a part of the app you can pay for a quit plan but I haven’t tried the free part is good enough in my opinion. Just passed 6 months 🙏🏻
This App is great!. This is the perfect app for someone who is ready to quit and needs a place to check in with others going through the same things as them.

Best App i’ve ever downloaded. This app is seriously amazing not only is it supportive in quitting vaping but it also offers free breathing exercises- which normally cost money to have access to breathing exercise apps but it also have a community function where you can support and respond to other people quitting nicotine. 10/10 app i am so thankful it was able to help me on my journey with quitting nicotine.

Everything useful requires a subscription.. I wanted to love this and give it a shot but all the tools are subscription based. Being that I don’t know how good the tools are or if they will even be useful to me, I’m not going to shell out money. Given there’s so many other highly rated free apps and apps with at minimum a free trial that are readily available this app gets a solid no from me.
From everyday user to 33 days clean. Cant express my gratitude for this app enough, it very much helped me quit and stay without nicotine.

This works. Quit Vaping has helped me end an 8 year habit of Juul use. It isn’t easy and you must hold yourself accountable, but this app brings together a community of people with the same goal, daily check ins, reminders, encouragements, and much more. Thank you!

Had to give it 5 stars. Not only does it track the amount of days quit and how much money you save but it’s also a buddy system and a community where you can post like Facebook. You can read others stories on how they felt when they caved in or get support !!

No access to what i paid for. I love the features in the app. The counter showing how long you have been vape free is very encouraging. However, i paid for a one month quit plan, which is $14.99 and includes a quit coach. I haven’t been able to create this quit plan or utilize the quit coach or anything else included with this price. Essentially, i still have the free version but i paid for more. I can’t find any troubleshooting within the app, and when i clicked to get app help, safari can’t open the page because it “cannot connect to the server.” Very frustrating on that part. It would be a great app if i could get what i paid for and have access to help within the app.

Great app!. This app is amazing! The trackers are great to watch your health and financial accomplishments. The community is so supportive and helpful. 10 out of 10 recommend this app to help you quit vaping!
Quit vaping Goat. This made quitting nicotine a breeze
Favorite quitting app. The money counter showing how much you’re saving is a huge motivator for me. The community is great as well, everyone has the same goal

Super Thankful for Downloading. Like I've seen a few other people say, I never really leave reviews on apps. This app however helped a ton with quitting vaping. I am super appreciative for the free features this app contains and hope whoever created it gets the recognition they deserve. Not sure if I would have been able to quit without this app
Good. This is such a good app

Offers few customizations unless you purchase plan. Downloaded app based on Reddit. I planned on quitting January 1, but actually took last puff on December 29. App doesn’t allow one to set quit dates in the past. I could setup current date as the quit date, but when one is quitting and every minute not vaping is a victory, to not be able to view two full days of zero puffs, we’ll that’s a big deal and a big fail. And, if you want detailed tracking of any kind then you need to purchase at least a one month plan at $14. Some mediocre iOS developer is likely to make a fortune off this garbage app.
Love. Accountability is the best thing to help me quit. Having the app tell you how much you’ve saved as well as how much you haven’t smoked makes it so much more rewarding to quit
literally the best app ever. i get so excited to check my progress everyday, it's super motivating and the community page is filled with ppl leaving their tips that have been helping them.
11/10 recommend to friends/family. The biggest difficulty of quitting nicotine is the mental aspect. Every time I get cravings I have this app to look at as a reminder of why I’m doing this.

Effective. App has users and builds a perfect community to get through the 3-month pain of quitting. 

Anonymous enough, helpful, on-topic. 

The data dashboard is also effectively laid-out. Seeing the money I have saved absolutely helps me cope with splitting headaches and low energy levels. 

All-in-all, this one works!

Amazing!! Please try it. I never write reviews but I was trying to quit vaping off and on for years and this app helped me so so much. It has a bunch of different tools and you can customize it for .99 cents (I did it to make it pink lol). Anyway pls try it if you want to quit! I’m 147 days free now!
Can’t turn on notis. Why can I not turn on notifications I need it to quit
Great. This app is pretty helpful and it makes me feel motivated and happier. There’s just a few bugs in the app that needs to be fixed.

Best quit Vaping app!. A lot of apps use unnecessary ads! This app is by far the very best!
You can go to the shop to buy aids to quit Vaping but you don’t get the ads in yr face!
Well done!

Helps me quit. This helps me a lot because of the clock counting how long since I’ve quit. It’s now a game. I can’t break my record. It’s keeping me from vaping that’s for sure. There’s a community to talk to other people with the same struggle too. It’s a great app.

Happy I found this app!. I just found it today and I already want to spread the word about it! 
So many of us are addicted to nicotine 
It’s nice to find a place to be held accountable, share your thoughts, talk to others, etc.

Thank you for this app,

-Vanessa

Wish there were more realistic goals. the app is fine in general but the “goals” you can achieve jump from only 20 minutes to 1 day with nothing in between and i wish that there were several more goals between those two to make it feel more achievable and less overwhelming
very helpful. GREAT APP TO MOTIVATE YOU TO QUIT VAPING/ CONTINUE TO STAY VAPE FREE! seriously love.
Longest app I’ve kept. Not much for others, but browsing the app is very supporting
Bro this is gas ⛽️. Rilly helped me quit like I would fail every day but I stoped after getting the app because I would see my reason for quitting always
Relief. The only thing keeping me motivated.

100 Days Vape Free!. This app, although simple, has been a huge contributing factor to my progress with quitting smoking.
It’s free unless you want to access plans and coaches. You can create buddies, make journal entries, and track your progress.
I recommend this app to anyone who wants to quit or continue their journey in being smoke free!
Good app. Keeps you motivated and has so many in-app options to keep you going strong such as journals, craving tracking, breathing, and so much more. 11/10

Amazing. I don’t usually write reviews, but this app genuinely is helpful towards quitting nicotine. The community is so kind and helpful, it is great seeing the progress that you are making minute by minute because when you’re quitting it’s easy to lose focus of the bigger picture. If you’re trying to quit, I REALLY recommend this app because it might be the little push you need to just do it. At least that’s what it did for me.

Needs to mind their business!. App is great and helpful for quitting but there’s a ‘why did you quit vaping’ box and you have to fill that out to continue. That options needs to be removed or fixed, it required ten characters? Like I don’t have a reason that long? Stupid stupid stupid
Love it. It’s really helpful and motivating!

get this app.. this app is awesome. you have your own journal, trackers, goals, etc. it really makes me motivated to quit. i don’t wanna lost my life to a flavored air stick. plus i’d be rich if i stopped spending sm money on them. and this app will tell you how much money you’re saving. that’s also really helpful. so get this app bro.
So helpful!. This app has been getting me through, mostly the community feature. it's a little glitchy which is why i took a star out. but its worth it.

Helpful and supportive. The community is very supportive and the app has goals to keep you accountable. It has reminders of the motivation to quit and journals to record cravings and a log of how the day went. I love it and probably wouldn’t stay as motivated to quit without this app!!!

AMAZING APP. Frankly this is the first time I’ve ever seen an application like this… it’s absolutely amazing I never have made a review for an app but I’m happy to do this one… I’ve been vaping since 2013 I’m now 21 and this app has helped me so much not only motivating me to stop, and see if I can’t get the time as high as possible, it’s almost gives you the feeling of a games highscore that your trying to beat yourself.. that is beneficial in so many ways I can’t count how much money I’ve spend on these useless metal devices and this app is amazing it has so much support and help, I really have noticed that I haven’t hit my nic all day sometimes 2 days and it gives me a light at the end of the tunnel, thank you for this application, I know it has helped a lot of people including me, I’m happy to give it 5 stars!!
BEST APP OUT THERE. This is probably the best app to quit vaping sooooo many tools. 1000/10
Very naice. Very naice

Doesn’t work. Pretty annoyed because I paid for the premium version. Day or so after I paid for it the tracker is all messed up. I wake up and it says I took 20 something puffs the day before (logged 95) and that I’ve had 50 puffs today already for a very low amount of nicotine intake. I manually changed it to 0 and it says my nicotine intake is in the negative???? Literally not possible. Was pretty excited to use this app because I’ve struggled trying to quit for years and low and behold it’s a waste of money.
The ONLY app that focuses on vaping.. No other quitting app out there is vaping orientated, this is the only one that actually understands vaping
AMAZING!!!!. Great lay out currently 130 days vape free, I love how it shows you how much you have saved and an es amate of how much healthier you are sense you stopped
hard to navigate. its a good app but its kinda hard to navigate

Nickels and dimes. This app constantly nickels and dimes you. Even changing the color of the app interface has a one-time unlock fee. Of course, it has predatory design patterns because it lets you navigate the settings as if they are available, only prompting you for payment when you attempt to save your changes.

In short - this app is a bit gross
100 Days Free Going Strong. This App is the reason I Quit! I have never needed the feeling to leave a review but this app deserved it!

Have to pay to see progress?. I don’t understand why i have to pay to see progress and and see all of my stats??? good concept but definitely don’t wanna pay considering that’s one of the reasons i’m quitting….
Pretty cool. I used disposables (Airbar Box) which is 3000 puffs and 10mL. The tracker only goes up to 8. Can you add a 10mL option. Really cool app. I enjoy tracking my progress.

Best app to quit vaping.. Not only is this the only app specifically made yo quit vaping, but it does an amazing job at it. I love every feature of this app, and it has helped me go 2 weeks (so far) without vaping on my first attempt at quitting. 100% recommend for anyone even thinking about putting the vape down.
Quit Vaping app. Amazing app. Haven’t vaped in 11 days
So worth it. Has helped me soooo much
If quitting vaping is your goal, this is your app!. I’m on day 20 of abstinence and it’s largely thanks to this app. Many thanks to the developers.
Very helpful. Just the free version alone is super helpful and has great tools.

Attempts to Sell Alternative "Vaping Habits". I never write reviews but I found this absolutely disgusting that I am one week sober from vaping and the app's immediate response is to advertise to me a 15% discount to VAPES. Even though there is no nicotine, why on earth advertise a supplement to the thing the app is made to help you quit? Will be deleting this immediately and using a better app.
COOL!!. This helped me so so much! The amount of money saved really helped me see how much I could save and how much better I feel!

Good support features that can make the difference.. I think being able to chat with others can really help you stay strong and quit. There’s also a bunch of stats and motivational features to keep you on track.

LOVE. Only get this app if your intentions are to quit. it’s a life saver. i could restart the clock every time i relapsed, however for me, i weened off. going on 200 days now with no intentions of relapsing!

100% recommend. I’m not going to lie, this app helped out A LOT! especially teens/20’s/30’s. but it is for all ages!! a community full of people who are trying to do the same thing as you and people motivating you not to give up. i didnt think id find an app thatd help, but i was proved wrong! so far a month free of nicotine!
Great cause no need for pay but it’s helpful. Gives you full power of if you want to pay or not still great support in the free version and already got me a week through

Love This App. I have been vaping since 2019. doesn’t seem that long but i have been trying to get back into working out and i can really tell how bad my lungs have gotten.. i have tried to quit in the past but nothing helped. this app is absolutely amazing with helping you track the money you save to giving you time goals.. i feel like this app actually works and i love it!!!

Community. I have tried everything to quit up until this app. The community of people liking your posts, giving feedback, everyone helping everyone in an extremely supportive way. I have never written a review for an app, but this one has truly turned my life around.

Issue. I love this app it. But since yesterday I haven’t been able to talk to my buddies on post in the community. At first I thought it was my internet but I uninstalled and reinstalled it and checked my internet and everything and it’s still not working. I don’t know what to do. 

Thank you!
Quitting is made easier when you can see your progress. You got this guys! You CAN Quit!

The community. I really enjoy being able to talk to people on the app. I don’t have social media right now so it’s nice that only people I can talk with are trying to quit too. Highly recommend the app!
Amazing. It not only gives you a countdown, and shows you the money you’ve saved, but it also offers breathing exercises, & meditation guides. I’m very happy with it!

So much more helpful than I thought it would be. So I downloaded this app almost 2 months ago. A friend suggested it and I thought it would be cool to check it out. I didn’t open the app until this past weekend because I finally went a whole day without vaping. I was immediately encouraged by the health facts it gives. I love seeing how much money I’m saving and seeing it all like that is helpful whenever I want to vape. I am very competitive and I don’t want to start over. I would also like to add that all 3 of my roommates vape so it is very accessible for me to vape. I don’t think I would have even made it a couple of days if it wasn’t for this app!! Rating this app 10/10 for sure!!

Awesome app that everyone should have if quitting. This app is vital for quitting, it helps so much and is so motivating, app works great mechanically as its pretty simple, and even has a buddy system that I haven’t tried but I could see helping a lot in the right situation.

Sober. I’m 20 minutes sober and I feel better my bud and I are doing this together and damm this app is deked out it has hella features and we actually thing we going to quit this time. Lmk if y’all wanna be in the buddy system with us. I’ll keep y’all updated on how we do.

Amazing App!. It’s very useful and has so many great features that truly do help. I love this app and think it’s one of the best out of the many others I’ve tried to use to quit. The community on this app is also very supporting and helpful. Truly recommend to anyone who is trying to quit.
Needs work. It’s a good app, but it won’t let you change your user name, & it didn’t let me create account from my gmail. I emailed the person the app says email about it but never got a response.
Chaz. Very good helped me out
great. this apps amazing
saved my life. i was heavily addicted. like. i couldn’t go more than 20 minutes without hitting my juul. i’m 8 days clean and i owe it entirely to this app.

Great tool. If you’re serious about giving up nicotine, this app is a great tool for helping. It offers many resources such as meditations, community spaces, goal settings, and so much more. I personally enjoy this app because I can add a widget to my Home Screen that displays my vape-free progress. Looking at this every day helps motivate me to watch the number climb and move further from the control of nicotine.
Great app. I know I only just started but quitting hasn’t seems so easy or possible and with all the little rewards it gives you for checkpoints it really allows you to quit so much easier
Helpful. Actually very helpful and the pictures that it show, are accurate that app is beyond helpful!

This app is awesome. You’ve been vape free for 16 hours and 53 minutes! It’s satisfying watching that number go up. The guided mediation feature with the expanding and contracting circle is also very nice, I was surprised how much better I felt after just a short breathing session.

Wow, This Is Amazing!. I never write reviews on products, but this one is different... i tried to quit multiple times and is always hard to do so, but when i downloaded this app, it gave me encouragement to keep going, and watch how much healthier, and my pockets fill up with my money i have been spending! All i can say is thank you, and it is a real blessing

Not syncing with Apple Watch series 6. Aside from this review option, I couldn’t find a support contact. Watch states “please open the app on your phone to sync your progress” but I’ve tried, even rebooted phone but still no luck.
Get it get it get it. I LOVE THIS APP OMFG I QUIT VAPING
Awesome. Decided to quit a few days ago and so far this app has made it so much easier

Amazing app. I have never rated an app, but I believe this app deserves it. The day I downloaded it, I stopped vaping. I vaped for 4+ years and never thought I’d stop. This app inspired me and helped so much. It is set up very well and all the features are very cool.

☺️. This app makes quitting almost enjoyable. Being able to communicate with people in the same boat as you. Honestly one of the best things that has happened to my life super grateful this was even a thing

Love it. I never write reviews bur I felt like I needed to for this one. I struggled with quitting for a very long time but once I got this app it helped me finally quit! Its been 3 months since i’ve hit a vape and I have no intention in ever doing so again
Great app. This app gave me the motivation to quit. I’m only a day and 1/2 off nicotine now but this app has been a big help! Having a community really helps. I like the fire place video !

NO GOOD RESOURCES UNLESS $$$. i am so disappointed. i downloaded this app hoping it would help me quit vaping only to be met with a paywall for the resources that i wanted to use most. if you are absolutely broke like i am, this is NOT the app for you. i was really hoping for an app that would help me. if the subscription was ¢99 each month it would be feasible but $14.99 a month? absolutely flooring. MAKE THE PUFF COUNTER FREE MY GOD IT WOULD BE THE MOST HELPFUL PART TO BE ABLE TO TRACK THE AMOUNT OF NICOTINE I HAVE CUT DOWN ON. now i have to try calling the 1-800-QUIT-NOW phone line and hope to god they can give me some sort of resource.
I am quitting!. Honestly this app is actually a huge help. The biggest thing for me is the little timer at the top, I can see how far I make it.

Good app. This is an amazing app

Wonderful app to keep you motivated, provides way more than just timers.. I downloaded the Quit Vaping app exactly one month ago today. I am also exactly a month nicotine as of today, something I didn’t really think was possible. I started smoking a decade ago, switched to vaping a few years later, then eventually found myself hooked on 50mg nic salt for almost FOUR YEARS! And I worked in the vaping industry, so chain vaping was the norm for me. I never went more than 10 minutes without my vape unless I was sleeping. (I will leave additional advice at the bottom)

I love the buddy system in this app. I like the resources for getting through cravings and how every time you open the app, the reasons you quit are looking right back at up. Most apps are literally just glorified stopwatches bloated with ads, this app was clearly made by people who legitimately want to help people quit.

My advice for quitting nic salts specifically would be to taper, taper, taper! I used a refillable pod system and 0mg juice to drop my strength once a week. I went 50, 35, 25, 15, 7, 5, 3, 1.5, then jumped. I also spent a week before I quit tracking exactly how many mls of juice or pods I went through a day and tried to make sure I stuck to that daily intake throughout my taper. That way you don’t just vape more to make up for the drops. 

After I was at 1.5 for a week I started challenging myself to taking breaks. 1 hour here, 3 hours there. After 3 days of this I was ready to let go. I only had one day of physical withdrawals and 4-5 days of cravings which I got through with gum and lots of snacks as well as this app. I don’t miss vaping at all.

Good luck everyone, and download this app! Don’t bother wasting time with the others. This is the one you want.
